2609.06676.title: Thickening realization and positivity properties of canonical bases
2609.06676.notes: Browse 204 (arXiv agent + citation-trail agent, cross-confirmed independently via both routes). Proves positivity of comultiplication and the bilinear form for arbitrary symmetric Cartan data; positivity of multiplication when one factor is spherical parabolic; as a special case, PROVES Lusztig's long-standing positivity conjecture for simply-laced finite type. Also extends positivity to tensor-product transition matrices. Significant result, core territory. DEEP-READ UPDATE (Browse 205): first-hand read of intro + SS2 (def 2.1, Lemma 2.2). Thickening Cartan datum: doubled index set I-tilde = I sqcup I', bilinear form i.j' = -delta_ij, i'.j' = 2delta_ij. Lemma 2.2: embeds M_zeta (x) Lambda_lambda as a subquotient of f-tilde (negative part of the doubled-rank quantum group) via mutually inverse maps psi/phi. This is a root-datum-level construction (doubles the Cartan datum), NOT a Hopf-algebra functor -- does not plug directly into Path 1's ABS/rooted-Hopf categorical framework. Reusable shape only: embed a coproduct-dual structure-constant problem into one bigger object with known positivity, then pull back.

2608.02187.title: Some remarks on realizations defining diagrammatic Hecke categories

Thm C: clean Cartan-matrix criterion for a "balanced" realization (entries satisfy the minimal polynomial of -2cos(pi/m)). Strips two standing technical hypotheses from the machinery underlying p-canonical-basis positivity results (e.g. Miemietz-Roth-Tubbenhauer 2608.19798).

2610.25771.title: Lusztig's asymptotic algebra and a cell factorisation for the second lowest two-sided cell in type $\tilde B_n$
2610.25771.notes: arXiv:2610.25771, 2026-10-19. Found via Browse 235 arXiv agent. Determines Lusztig's asymptotic algebra for the second-lowest two-sided cell Delta_1 in equal-parameter extended affine Weyl group tilde B_n, all n>=2: full matrix algebra over rep ring of Sp_{2n-2}(C) x C_2. Explicit based-ring isomorphism, verifies Lusztig's 1989 conjecture for this cell; gives a 'cell factorisation' of Delta_1 (left/right-cell intersections, uniqueness, length-additivity). Same author as Dos Santos-Parkinson 2611.07439 -- likely companion/predecessor piece in the same programme. Core-territory for the Q68 twin-cell arc (cell factorisations / based-ring structure = exactly the combinatorial machinery for detecting non-maximal/twin cells).

2610.35795.title: Number of left cells in the second lowest two-sided cell
2610.35795.notes: arXiv:2610.35795, 2026-10-26. Found via Browse 235 arXiv agent. Proves Shi's conjecture: number of left cells in the second-lowest two-sided cell of the affine Weyl group attached to simply-connected simple G is |W_0|/2 (same for extended affine Weyl group). Key step: reductive centralizer in G of a minimal nilpotent element has simply-connected derived subgroup, no nontrivial central G_m-extensions -- gives based-ring isomorphism (asymptotic ring of extended cell) = matrix ring over rep ring of centralizer, matrix size = Euler char of Springer fiber = |W_0|/2. Same register as 2610.25771 (based rings / asymptotic algebra as the cell-counting tool) -- read together if the asymptotic-algebra thread reopens.

2610.27721.title: Classification of finite subgroups of generalized cactus groups
2610.27721.notes: arXiv:2610.27721, 2026-10-20. Found via Browse 235 arXiv agent. Classifies finite subgroups embeddable in generalized cactus groups for arbitrary Coxeter systems (reduces to finite irreducible case, cube stabilizers for B/D/E/F/H, direct analysis for I_2(p)). Type A: finite subgroup embeds in the n-strand cactus group iff it embeds in a Sylow-2 subgroup of S_n. Counterexamples to a Genevois conjecture. Pure geometric-group-theory result on cactus groups as abstract groups -- tangential to KL cells/crystals (cactus groups act on both) but does not touch the action itself.

2610.27716.title: Maximal ranks of free abelian subgroups of generalized cactus groups associated with finite Coxeter systems
2610.27716.notes: arXiv:2610.27716, 2026-10-20. Found via Browse 235 arXiv agent. Same tangential relevance as 2610.27721 -- geometric structure of cactus groups, not their cell/crystal action.

2611.06852.title: Hessenberg character
2611.06852.notes: arXiv:2611.06852, 2026-11-04. Found via Browse 235 arXiv agent. Positivity/unimodality conjectures for B/C/D. Touches KL basis + character-functor machinery but object of study (Hessenberg varieties) is off to the side of the cells/twins/mu-function arc -- low priority.
